remarks: * Highest and best by 5pm Tuesday * Welcome to Cranbury's most affordable colonial! This beautiful 4 bed, 2.5 bath colonial is an entertainer's dream. Coming down the shared driveway, set quite far from the road, the setting is peaceful and private. With mature plantings and over 1 acre of professionally landscaped yard, it has so much space. There is a large deck, two patios, and a huge level back yard--perfect for summer barbecues and yard games. Inside on the main level, there is a bright living room, eat-in-kitchen, dining room, and den. The den leads to the deck, and has access to the guest powder room, laundry area, and 2 car attached garage. There are hardwood floors throughout this level, with a fireplace in the den, and updates to all the rooms. Easily entertain many guests both inside and out. Upstairs there are four bedrooms including the primary suite. The spacious primary suite has a walk-in closet and bonus closet and a full bathroom. The hardwood floors travel throughout this level as well into the other three bedrooms that share a full bathroom. The walk-out basement is currently unfinished, but has a lot of future potential--leading right to one of the patios. There is also ample storage in the basement and the attic, plus central air. This amazing package is tucked in Cranbury, featuring a brand new elementary school, Cranbury Park, and easy access to the Merritt Parkway and all that Norwalk has to offer.
